chunks: And Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Dharīḥ al-Muḥāribī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

Whoever dies and has not performed the hajj of Islam, while nothing prevented him from that—neither a need that would devastate him, nor an illness because of which he is unable to perform hajj, nor a ruler preventing him from it—then let him die a Jew or a Christian.

key_terms.الْحَجَّ: the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.تُجْحِفُ بِهِ: that causes severe loss or hardship to him
key_terms.حَجَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ: the obligatory hajj required in Islam
key_terms.لَا يُطِيقُ: he is not capable of bearing or performing

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about dying without performing the obligatory hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith strongly warns against neglecting the obligatory hajj when one has the ability to perform it. It emphasizes that abandoning hajj without a valid excuse is an extremely grave matter with severe spiritual consequences.
